verdict.rationale: Gladia documents its own audio-intelligence features that produce AI-generated insights from a user's audio: LLM prompts run directly on audio, sentiment and emotion extraction, summarization, and named entity recognition. These are delivered as API add-ons, and only one-line documentation supports them. Missing for 10: any evidence of proactive suggestions or recommendations, an in-product insights interface beyond API output, in-depth docs on what the LLM features return, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use the power of LLMs directly on your audios without a third party service.
